title: Light Crunchy Egyptian Turkey Neck Kebabs
description: A resinous and crunchy Egyptian dish featuring turkey neck, tadka, and Mediterranean-friendly flavors, perfect for a light meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the turkey neck pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated turkey neck pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the turkey is cooked through and slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the oven and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
